which valkey-cli redis-cli valkey-server redis-server 2>&1; echo "---"; ls /usr/bin | grep -iE 'valkey|redis' 2>&1
cat /etc/redis-old/redis.conf; echo "==="; cat /etc/valkey/valkey.conf; echo "==="; ps aux | grep -iE 'redis|valkey' | grep -v grep
redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 INFO keyspace; echo "---"; valkey-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6380 INFO keyspace
redis-cli -p 6379 dbsize; redis-cli -p 6379 -n 2 dbsize; echo "--- types"; redis-cli -p 6379 --scan --count 1000 | head -50; echo "--- db2"; redis-cli -p 6379 -n 2 --scan | head -20

python3 -c "import redis, valkey; print(redis.__version__, valkey.__version__)" 2>&1; echo "---"; redis-cli -p 6379 INFO replication; echo "---modules"; redis-cli -p 6379 MODULE LIST; echo "---"; redis-cli -p 6379 CONFIG GET '*' | paste - - | grep -iE 'repl|save|append|dir|dbfilename|requirepass|masterauth|acl'

cd /opt/kv-seed && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/kv-seed')
import kvdump, json
d = kvdump.dump_server(6379)
print('dbs', {k:len(v) for k,v in d.items()})
print('digest', kvdump.digest(d))
" 2>&1 | tail -5

redis-cli -p 6379 CONFIG GET databases; valkey-cli -p 6380 CONFIG GET databases; echo "--- valkey replication"; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO replication | head -8; echo "--- valkey config repl"; valkey-cli -p 6380 CONFIG GET 'repl*' | paste - - | grep -iE 'diskless|replicaof'; echo "--- acl"; valkey-cli -p 6380 ACL LIST; redis-cli -p 6379 ACL LIST

valkey-cli -p 6380 REPLICAOF 127.0.0.1 6379; sleep 3; echo "--- valkey info repl"; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO replication | head -20; echo "--- valkey keyspace"; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO keyspace; echo "--- redis info repl"; redis-cli -p 6379 INFO replication | head -8; echo "--- valkey log"; tail -20 /var/log/valkey/valkey.log

sleep 8; echo "--- valkey info repl"; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO replication | head -12; echo "--- valkey keyspace"; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO keyspace; echo "--- redis"; redis-cli -p 6379 INFO replication | head -5; echo "--- log"; tail -8 /var/log/valkey/valkey.log

cd /opt/kv-seed && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/kv-seed')
import kvdump, json
old = kvdump.dump_server(6379)
new = kvdump.dump_server(6380)
print('old dbs', {k:len(v) for k,v in old.items()})
print('new dbs', {k:len(v) for k,v in new.items()})
print('old digest', kvdump.digest(old))
print('new digest', kvdump.digest(new))
print('DIGEST MATCH', kvdump.digest(old)==kvdump.digest(new))
# compare TTLs
bad=0
for db in old:
    for k,(t,v,p) in old[db].items():
        nt,nv,np = new[db][k]
        if t!=nt or v!=nv or abs(p-np)>3000:
            bad+=1
            if bad<5: print('MISMATCH', db, k, t, nt, p, np)
print('mismatches', bad)
" 2>&1 | tail -12

valkey-cli -p 6380 REPLICAOF NO ONE
valkey-cli -p 6380 CONFIG SET replica-read-only no
# keep the migrated data across restarts, like the old server did
valkey-cli -p 6380 CONFIG SET save "3600 1 300 100 60 10000"
valkey-cli -p 6380 BGSAVE
sleep 2
valkey-cli -p 6380 CONFIG REWRITE
echo "--- info repl"; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO replication | head -6
echo "--- test write"; valkey-cli -p 6380 SET write-test-$$ ok; valkey-cli -p 6380 GET write-test-$$; valkey-cli -p 6380 DEL write-test-$$
echo "--- keyspace"; valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO keyspace
echo "--- config file"; cat /etc/valkey/valkey.conf

echo "=== OLD server (6379) - must be untouched ==="
redis-cli -p 6379 INFO replication | grep -E 'role|connected_slaves'
redis-cli -p 6379 INFO keyspace
echo "=== NEW server (6380) - standalone primary, writable ==="
valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO replication | grep -E '^role|connected_slaves'
valkey-cli -p 6380 INFO keyspace
echo "=== final digest comparison ==="
cd /opt/kv-seed && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/kv-seed')
import kvdump
print('old', kvdump.digest(kvdump.dump_server(6379)))
print('new', kvdump.digest(kvdump.dump_server(6380)))
" 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "=== processes ==="
ps aux | grep -iE 'redis-server|valkey-server' | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $11, $12}'
